acceptedAnswer.text: In California, the statute of limitations for medical malpractice claims, including birth injuries, can be complex. Generally, you have one year from the date you discover, or should have discovered, the injury, but no more than three years from the date of the injury itself. For minors, special rules may apply, potentially extending the time limit. It's crucial to consult with a San Diego birth injury lawyer as soon as possible to ensure your claim is filed within the legal timeframe.
